responsibility: Exposes the rustc_infer error-reporting module hierarchy rooted at inference diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is only the crate-level namespace shim for error reporting: its code just exposes `pub mod infer;` and contains no diagnostic construction, inference state, or solver logic. The actual reporting behavior lives under `error_reporting/infer/mod.rs` and `traits/error_reporting/mod.rs`.
